messages:
maya: quick PSA 1: our v1->v2 soft-deprec rollout is causing routing oscillation for a small set of tenants. console shows 'compat.switchbacks' spikes.
sam: saw it. looks like the pin-unpin logic is racing with our new loyalty cache. tenant affinity flips when cached header variants arrive out-of-order.
ana: logs: two sequential requests for same token; first lacks `x-tenant-feature` so route->v2; second has it, route->v1 and affinity updates back. affinity TTL is 5s, churn high.
michael: short-term: increase affinity debounce to 30s and enable a tie-break rule `prefer_current_route=true` to avoid oscillation on rapid retried calls.
maya: agree. also, can we surface an "oscillation score" on the routing dashboard so ops can see which tenants are bouncing? current alert pulls only absolute fallback counts.
sam: good ask. add metric `routing.oscillation_rate{tenant}` and expose per-tenant sparkline in the rollouts page.
ana: UI note: add a small badge on tenant row: "oscillating" with hover explaining: "multiple conflicting compatibility signals within TTL causing route flips". ops wants ability to click and apply "stabilize" which sets debounce=30s for that tenant.
michael: backend quick patch: accept `route_debounce_seconds` in tenant override; default remains 5s but stabilize action sets to 30s. I'll push patch then schedule a hot-config update.
ops-bot: scheduled hot-config update for tenant @gamma-prod to set route_debounce_seconds=30.
maya: follow-ups: michael -> patch + hot-config; ana -> add osc metric to telemetry pipeline; sam -> add stabilize action to rollout console; I'll update support playbook (muting deprecation banners while stabilize active).
ana: copy for badge tooltip: "Stabilize applied: routing debounce increased to reduce version flip-flop. Consider keeping for contracts with bursty traffic"
michael: I'll also add a guard that if osc_rate>0.5% for 10m auto-apply stabilize for that tenant and notify on the incident channel.
sam: thanks all. small change should buy time while we fix header normalization logic end-to-end. reconvene if any customer reports after the hot-config deploy.
